page.overview:
Who is Abby Miller?

Abby Miller and her father were targeted by the Hand, but their new found friend Elektra was there to protect them. Abby and Elektra both ran through army of the Hand ninjas, defeated Tattoo and Typhoid and then finally killed Kirigi - the leader of the Hand.

After that Abby wanted to forget the ninja stuff and become a cheerleader, but Elektra talked her out of it and seemingly trained her so Abby could become an even more skilled fighter.
